about: What the integrator of window 6 (W3.1-bis.9, the descriptions of the catalogue) did by hand, each with its reason, so that window-6-catalogue.js --check holds it like the rest. forced_units: units the gate does not read as Italian that the window still changes (the English paragraphs of the descriptions that declare a limit in another form than the keyword); code_changes: the few changes of code, as a snippet of the tree before the window and what it becomes; overrides: a translation accepted with a flag the translator gave (length_ok, keywords_ok, quoted_ok, protocol_ok), by file and unit; examples: operations whose example changes (a name of the SOLIDWORKS tree, D12). protocol_values: by operation, the values its code takes as they are (read from the code, not from a case of the bench) that a description must keep naming, written in ROT13 (values_rot13: they are Italian, and this file is judged by the language gate); the protocol guard of --apply holds them like the values a case passes.

forced_units.why: descriptions of arguments in Italian that the detector reads as English (lone Italian infinitives with a clitic, «solo con»): fix_component.grounded (translated in the review of the pilot) and the two arguments of the second direction of linear_pattern (they go with the features family). Found by the reader of the blind spots of --check, which lists the catalogue texts the detector passes and that carry Italian function words

code_changes.why: the new contract of the refusal keyword (Tests/RefusalKeywordsContract.cs) is a group of the run like the others; the file is new, and this is the one line that runs it

overrides.why: replace_component: the Italian paragraph declared the limit in the middle of the sentence («if you give it the same file ... I refuse»); the review of the pilot writes it with the one keyword, so the declarations of the unit go from 0 to 1

protocol_values.why: MateOperations.cs takes «variant» and «alignment» only as these words (the switch on the variant, the comparison for the opposite alignment); the bench passes four of the six, and a translator that rendered the other two in English would teach the model a value the operation refuses. They leave when the values are renamed (D1/.5) or an exception class is signed (.11)
